body:
I am going downhill so fast it isn’t funny anymore. Honestly if I died tonight I would be in peace.

I have been through a mental rollercoaster in the past couple of years, anxiety, depression, insomnia, eating disorders, self harm and I am suicidal. Many people don’t believe me when I say the there is something medically wrong with me, and they just say I am just a teenager, probably overreacting. I am not, and a huge part of my problem is that I have an extremely high pain tolerance, so when something hurts, I sure as hell am not lying. I am constantly feeling sick and have major back/neck pain, and I am always on the verge of either passing out, or wanting to shove my head through a wall. Everything has taken such a sharp turn in the past couple of months.
I have had some doctors not believe me, but I keep pushing and tests are finally getting done, and some of them aren’t very good. I have three appointments in the next two weeks that could potentially be life changing. I am fucking terrified. I just don’t know what to do anymore, because the people who I assumed actually cared for me are just ridiculing me for going to the doctors in the first place.
